_comment: Public-data reference engines for Concept 2. Shaft hp only: thermodynamic hp and equivalent shaft hp are not used as propeller shaft output. Retrieved 2026-11-06. These are reference hardware choices, not a certification of the proposed hybrid installation.

data_notes.ratings: GE brochure nominal 750/800 shp; EASA E.070 issue 09 p8 lists 560/597 kW for H75-100/H80-100 takeoff and maximum continuous, respectively. Nominal shp values are used to avoid spurious precision from rounded kW conversions. Do not substitute H80-200: its normal continuous rating is 522 kW, not 597 kW.
data_notes.dimensions_mass: EASA E.070 issue 09 p7: H75-100 and H80-100 dry mass 200 kg; overall length 1675 mm. Use these variant-specific TC values instead of the GE brochure basic dry mass 177 kg and approximate length 1670 mm. Installation equipment boundaries differ; installed-engine factor remains a separate preliminary assumption.
data_notes.chart_reading: GE brochure p2: sea-level and 10000-ft shaft-power curves against OAT. Anchor points below are manually read and rounded from plotted lines, not a tabulated engine deck. Approximate chart-reading allowance +/-15 shp is a study assumption, not a manufacturer tolerance.
data_notes.interpolation: Linear in OAT on each published altitude curve, then linear in pressure altitude between 0 and 10000 ft at the same ISA temperature deviation. Endpoint OATs follow their local ISA temperature plus that deviation. This avoids an artificial power dip along an ISA climb. Intermediate-altitude behavior is an engineering interpolation assumption. No altitude or temperature extrapolation.
data_notes.continuous_curve: Brochure does not give a separate maximum-continuous thermal map. Apply the brochure power ceiling capped by each variant's continuous rating as a preliminary assumption. ITT/RPM-specific continuous and cruise maps remain unresolved.
data_notes.installation: Public brochure reference output; no custom inlet, bleed, cooling, accessory or hybrid gearbox losses are established. The model returns turbine output before separately accounted custom installation loads. No ram-rise, restart, duration tracking or motor power is included.
data_notes.fuel: No fuel-flow map obtained from these sources. Retain requirements BSFC=0.6 lb/(shaft-hp hr) as an explicitly estimated constant; fuel-flow calculations are estimates, not GE data.
